Our Philosophy
We believe that exceptional wealth demands exceptional strategy. Every financial decision carries tax implications — and every tax decision shapes your financial future. At Anne Liang CPA, we sit at the intersection of both.

Comprehensive Tax Solutions

Tailored strategies designed for individuals and families with complex financial portfolios and multi-jurisdictional considerations.

Tax Planning & Strategy

Proactive, year-round tax planning that minimizes liabilities and maximizes after-tax wealth. We architect multi-year strategies aligned with your financial goals.

Learn more

Estate & Trust Advisory

Structured wealth transfer strategies that preserve family legacies while minimizing estate and gift tax exposure across generations.

Learn more

Investment Tax Optimization

Tax-efficient portfolio structuring, capital gains strategies, and qualified opportunity zone planning to enhance your investment returns.

Learn more

Business Entity Structuring

Strategic entity selection and restructuring to optimize pass-through income, self-employment taxes, and retirement plan contributions.

Learn more

International Tax

Cross-border tax compliance, FBAR and FATCA reporting, treaty optimization, and expatriation planning for global citizens.

Learn more

IRS Representation

Expert audit defense, tax dispute resolution, penalty abatement, and voluntary disclosure program guidance with former IRS experience.

Learn more

Our Process

A methodical, client-first approach that transforms complexity into clarity and tax liabilities into strategic advantage.

01

Discovery & Analysis

We conduct a comprehensive review of your financial landscape — income sources, investment portfolios, business interests, and long-term objectives.

02

Strategic Blueprint

Our team architects a customized tax strategy designed to minimize current liabilities while positioning you for future growth and wealth preservation.

03

Implementation & Monitoring

We execute with precision and continuously monitor legislative changes, market shifts, and life events that may require strategic adjustments.
